name: Saihouji Tokiwa
source:
A genius scientist, who achieved important results such as increasing the efficiency of solar panels to 12%. It is she who shaped the Island of Wind, which produces green electricity. For the entire past seven years, she hasn't been seen in public even once, which sparked numerous rumors. An eccentric and upright person who believes that lying is wrong and that all living creatures are equal and should not be killed lightly. Her father's upbringing is what caused her to turn out this way. Her main interest is sea creatures.

Tokiwa got a ticket to SHEEPIII's underwater voyage some time after telling her father that she was interested in going. It was the first time she observed sea creatures in their natural habitat with her own eyes. [i]Little did she know, to which nightmare her interest would lead...[/i]

[spoiler]It was she who offered a solution to the problem of isolating sea creatures in a certain area without hurting them by utilizing a technique based on bubble-net feeding. Because of that, ROMLES was able to minimize the harm caused by the COOS spill in Kurama Gulf, although unbeknownst to her, they used an ozone to trap infected creatures. In truth, seven years ago, prior to the "Forth Day" incident, she was infected with the Alice virus by her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c61548]Rumi[/url]. It was before the infection that she expressed her desire to go on the SHEEP's underwater voyage. Tokiwa was cured with gene therapy by restoring cryptochromes. That treatment method was invented by her father. There was a side effect—she became able to perceive magnetic fields. Still, she did not notice that she had slept for all seven years and did not know which year it truly was.[/spoiler]
